 # Agentic Loop Status
 
-Updated: 2026-09-01 03:12:00
+Updated: 2026-09-01 04:15:00
 
-- Run: agent iteration 14
+- Run: agent iteration 16
 - Stage: improving usable context OCR and learning-card quality
 - Goal: reliable sentence understanding plus memorable word learning
 - Independent review: required after each relevant committed change
 - Completion: automatic threshold or user acceptance
-- Hypothesis tested and rejected: when a longer OCR preprocessing variant fails `ContextQualityGate`, selecting a shorter gate-passing variant would recover a safe subtitle without changing selected-word OCR.
-- Evidence: inspected the real `frail` screenshot (`20260711-221147-107.png`) and manually transcribed its subtitle as "Her voice softens as she looks at the frail, slender girl in front of her." The selector probe replayed indices 200, 500, 563, 939, 1027, and 1127; output is preserved in `artifacts/context-trust-selector-after-20260901.json`.
-- Metric delta: selected-word OCR stayed 6/6 exact, no OCR regressions or replay failures, but contextual Top-1 stayed 2/5 against `artifacts/context-anchor-inflection-after-20260901.json`. `frail` still read "th slender" and correctly abstained; no readable alternative was recovered. The probe change was removed rather than retaining a unit-test-only rule.
-- Real examples and regressions: `bark` remained "The dog began to bark" and kept its verb sense; the corrupted `frail`, `staunch`, and `crack` contexts remained unable to support their expected main senses. No new product code is retained, so there is no shipped behavioral regression.
-- Next question: can per-variant OCR text for screenshot-backed, manually transcribed dialogue be captured and scored before selection, so preprocessing can be changed only where an actual alternate variant improves subtitle WER or trust-gate recall?
+- Hypothesis tested and rejected: WordNet examples from a part-of-speech bucket with more than one English definition are too weak to display as a learning hook, because the compact lexicon merges source synsets before the card can bind an example to the displayed Chinese gloss.
+- Evidence: `artifacts/learning-evidence-before-20260901.tsv` and `artifacts/learning-evidence-after-20260901.tsv` preserve 200 rendered-card outputs. `commute` demonstrates the defect: its broad verb gloss includes exchange, sentence reduction, and travel, while its displayed WordNet example is only "these operators commute with each other" (the mathematical sense).
+- Metric delta: the temporary fail-closed guard removed 76 weak/mixed cards, reducing source-bearing learning hooks from 90/200 (45%) to 14/200 (7%). diff --git a/docs/agentic-loop-status.md b/docs/agentic-loop-status.md
index c397231..a4058cd 100644
--- a/docs/agentic-loop-status.md
+++ b/docs/agentic-loop-status.md
@@ -1,14 +1,14 @@
 # Agentic Loop Status
 
-Updated: 2026-09-01 04:15:00
+Updated: 2026-09-01 05:12:00
 
 - Run: agent iteration 16
 - Stage: improving usable context OCR and learning-card quality
 - Goal: reliable sentence understanding plus memorable word learning
 - Independent review: required after each relevant committed change
 - Completion: automatic threshold or user acceptance
-- Hypothesis tested and rejected: WordNet examples from a part-of-speech bucket with more than one English definition are too weak to display as a learning hook, because the compact lexicon merges source synsets before the card can bind an example to the displayed Chinese gloss.
-- Evidence: `artifacts/learning-evidence-before-20260901.tsv` and `artifacts/learning-evidence-after-20260901.tsv` preserve 200 rendered-card outputs. `commute` demonstrates the defect: its broad verb gloss includes exchange, sentence reduction, and travel, while its displayed WordNet example is only "these operators commute with each other" (the mathematical sense).
-- Metric delta: the temporary fail-closed guard removed 76 weak/mixed cards, reducing source-bearing learning hooks from 90/200 (45%) to 14/200 (7%). This is below the goal's >=70% useful-learning-hint target, so the product code and test were removed rather than shipping a coverage regression. The retained 14 hooks were single-definition source buckets; no OCR or context-selection behavior was changed.
-- Real examples and regressions: `commute` correctly lost its misleading hook under the probe, while `bizarre`, `calibration`, and `therein` retained direct WordNet examples. The guard also removed useful-looking examples for 76 cards, so it is not an acceptable release behavior. The normal test suite passed while the probe was present; no product behavior is retained.
-- Next question: can the lexicon generator retain WordNet definition/example pairs as individual evidence units, and can a manually reviewed bilingual mapping bind an example to a specific displayed Chinese sense, without dropping learning coverage below 70%?
+- Hypothesis: keeping the selected word visible in the wider context crop gives the ranker an anchor for local syntax and improves sentence-sense selection; add only a reviewed `crack shot` adjective frame to cover the remaining high-signal game phrase.
+- Metric delta: on the fixed 20-candidate replay, OCR exact stayed 20/20, context coverage stayed 16/16, abstention accuracy stayed 4/4, and context Top-1 rose from 10/16 (62.5%) before to 14/16 (87.5%) after. Replay timeouts, failures, and OCR regressions were 0.
+- Real examples: `frail` now retains `frail, slender girl`; `crack` now resolves `crack shot`; `fortress` remains an honest abstention on `Finally, he is back in his fortress.` and `dome` remains an honest abstention on `...shattered dome`, showing the remaining syntax gap rather than forcing a meaning. The corrupted `staunch` crop still fails the context trust gate and does not steer the card.
+- Regressions: none observed in the focused .NET suite (27/27 passed) or the 20-sample production replay. The 14/16 labeled context score is below the goal's 90% Top-1 threshold, and the required 50-screenshot gold set and independent reviewer accepts are still absent. Learning-card provenance remains a separate unresolved gap.
+- Next question: can a conservative determiner-plus-head-noun frame resolve the remaining `fortress`/`dome` noun cases without converting malformed or semantically unrelated crops into confident senses?

using RealtimeTranslate.Core.Models;

namespace RealtimeTranslate.Core.Dictionary;

public sealed class MorphemeWordInsightService : IWordInsightService
{
    private readonly Dictionary<string, WordInsight> _entries = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public MorphemeWordInsightService(string wordCardsTsvPath)
    {
        if (!File.Exists(wordCardsTsvPath))
        {
            return;
        }
        foreach (var line in File.ReadLines(wordCardsTsvPath))
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line) || line.StartsWith('#'))
            {
                continue;
            }

            var fields = line.Split('\t');
            if (fields.Length < 4)
            {
                continue;
            }

            var word = fields[0].Trim();
            if (word.Length == 0)
            {
                continue;
            }

            // Four-column files combine ECDICT inflections, MorphyNet
            // relations, MorphoLex analyses, and locally curated hints.  The
            // row no longer says which field came from which source, so a
            // runtime label such as "MorphoLex (2018)" would be fabricated
            // provenance.  Fail closed: the dictionary can still provide a
            // separately attributed WordNet example, but this row must not
            // become a learning claim until the generator writes field-level
            // evidence.
            var parsed = 0d;
            var hasExplicitEvidence = fields.Length >= 6
                && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fields[4])
                && double.TryParse(fields[5], out parsed);
            var source = hasExplicitEvidence ? fields[4].Trim() : string.Empty;
            var confidence = hasExplicitEvidence ? Math.Clamp(parsed, 0, 1) : 0;
            var contextHint = hasExplicitEvidence ? fields[3].Trim() : string.Empty;

            _entries[word] = new WordInsight(
                fields[1].Trim(),
                fields[2].Split(',', StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries | StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries),
                contextHint,
                source,
                confidence);
        }
    }

    public WordInsight Lookup(string word)
    {
        return _entries.TryGetValue(word.Trim(), out var insight) ? insight : WordInsight.Empty;
    }
}
namespace RealtimeTranslate.Core.Models;

public sealed record WordInsight(
    string Breakdown,
    IReadOnlyList<string> Family,
    string ContextHint,
    string EvidenceSource = "",
    double Confidence = 0)
{
    public static WordInsight Empty { get; } = new(string.Empty, [], string.Empty);

    public bool HasEvidence => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(EvidenceSource) && Confidence > 0;
}
using RealtimeTranslate.Core.Models;

namespace RealtimeTranslate.Core.Presentation;

public static class LookupCardTextFormatter
{
    public static string Frequency(int band) => band switch
    {
        3 => "★★�?,
        2 => "★★�?,
        1 => "★☆�?,
        _ => string.Empty,
    };

    public static string Breakdown(LookupPresentation presentation) =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(presentation.WordBreakdown) ? string.Empty : $"词基/构词  {presentation.WordBreakdown}";

    public static string Family(LookupPresentation presentation) => presentation.WordFamily is { Count: > 0 }
        ? $"词族/词形  {string.Join(" · ", presentation.WordFamily.Take(3))}"
        : string.Empty;

    public static string Usage(LookupPresentation presentation) =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(presentation.ContextHint) ? string.Empty : $"用法/语境  {presentation.ContextHint}";

    public static string Evidence(LookupPresentation presentation) =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(presentation.InsightEvidence)
            ? string.Empty
            : $"证据  {presentation.InsightEvidence}";

    public static string ContextAlignment(LookupPresentation presentation) =>
        presentation.IsContextAligned ? "整句句意对齐：已用于筛�? : "整句句意对齐：未用于筛�?;

    public static IReadOnlyList<string> VisibleLines(LookupPresentation presentation)
    {
        var core = new[]
        {
            $"{presentation.Title} {Frequency(presentation.FrequencyBand)}".Trim(),
            presentation.PrimaryDefinition,
            presentation.IsError ? string.Empty : ContextAlignment(presentation),
        }.Where(line => line.Length > 0).ToList();

        // Keep the first screen compact: sentence meaning and usage outrank
        // study metadata. Show at most one optional metadata block so the
        // card never grows beyond five visible information blocks.
        var metadata = Breakdown(presentation);
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(metadata))
        {
            metadata = Family(presentation);
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(metadata))
        {
            core.Add(metadata);
        }

        var evidence = Evidence(presentation);
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(evidence))
        {
            core.Add(evidence);
        }

        // Provenance is part of the trust contract for learning content. When
        // the five-block first screen is full, keep the source-bearing line
        // and let the optional usage example yield space for it.
        var usage = Usage(presentation);
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(usage) && core.Count < 5)
        {
            core.Add(usage);
        }

        return core.Take(5).ToArray();
    }
}

# Agentic Loop Status

Updated: 2026-09-01 05:12:00

- Run: agent iteration 16
- Stage: improving usable context OCR and learning-card quality
- Goal: reliable sentence understanding plus memorable word learning
- Independent review: required after each relevant committed change
- Completion: automatic threshold or user acceptance
- Hypothesis: keeping the selected word visible in the wider context crop gives the ranker an anchor for local syntax and improves sentence-sense selection; add only a reviewed `crack shot` adjective frame to cover the remaining high-signal game phrase.
- Metric delta: on the fixed 20-candidate replay, OCR exact stayed 20/20, context coverage stayed 16/16, abstention accuracy stayed 4/4, and context Top-1 rose from 10/16 (62.5%) before to 14/16 (87.5%) after. Replay timeouts, failures, and OCR regressions were 0.
- Real examples: `frail` now retains `frail, slender girl`; `crack` now resolves `crack shot`; `fortress` remains an honest abstention on `Finally, he is back in his fortress.` and `dome` remains an honest abstention on `...shattered dome`, showing the remaining syntax gap rather than forcing a meaning. The corrupted `staunch` crop still fails the context trust gate and does not steer the card.
- Regressions: none observed in the focused .NET suite (27/27 passed) or the 20-sample production replay. The 14/16 labeled context score is below the goal's 90% Top-1 threshold, and the required 50-screenshot gold set and independent reviewer accepts are still absent. Learning-card provenance remains a separate unresolved gap.
- Next question: can a conservative determiner-plus-head-noun frame resolve the remaining `fortress`/`dome` noun cases without converting malformed or semantically unrelated crops into confident senses?
# Agent Loop Status

Updated: 2026-08-31

- Run: isolated replay evidence by accepting `--replay-output` in the app and assigning each verifier invocation and child replay a unique temporary lookup-record file. `Verify-ReplayCorpus.ps1` also recognizes the current explicit-abstention prefix. This prevents concurrent replay processes from shifting one card's output onto another source index.
- Evidence: the clean real Debug replay of all 20 game screenshots completed with zero timeouts/failures, `ocr_exact=20/20`, `dictionary_found=20/20`, `top1_sense=15/16`, available context `16/16`, context top-1 `15/16`, and labelled abstentions `4/4`: `artifacts/blind-review-source-explicit-uncertainty-clean-20260831.json`. `dotnet build RealtimeTranslateCodex.sln --no-restore` completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors; the executable suite passed 19/19.
- Blind-review evidence: `artifacts/blind-card-review-explicit-uncertainty-clean-20260831.json` was generated from that clean source. It contains 20 actual cards with all 20 decisions and rationales blank; card fields contain no expected sense/outcome or automated verdict. It is genuinely unreviewed and includes the new uncertainty wording.
- Remaining blocker: an independent human must complete that packet’s blinded `understandable` / `unclear` / `should-abstain` decision and rationale. No code change can supply this judgement; without it the product has neither the required human result nor the required 16 directly understood cards.
- Next: have a reviewer complete `artifacts/blind-card-review-explicit-uncertainty-clean-20260831.json` without opening `tests/Data/replay-expected.json`, then run `pwsh -File tools/Test-BlindCardReview.ps1 -ReviewPath <completed-review.json> -SummaryPath artifacts/blind-review-source-explicit-uncertainty-clean-20260831.json -OutputPath artifacts/blind-review-reconciliation-<date>.json`. param(
    [int]$SampleCount = 12,
    [int]$StartIndex = 0,
    [int]$DelayMilliseconds = 250,
    [int]$ReplaySettleMilliseconds = 1000,
    [int]$ReplayTimeoutSeconds = 30,
    [int]$MaxRunSeconds = 0,
    [string]$SummaryPath,
    [string]$ExpectedManifestPath,
    [string]$CandidateManifestPath,
    [int[]]$Indices,
    [switch]$Stratified
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$null = Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing
$repo = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$ExpectedManifestPath = if ($ExpectedManifestPath) { $ExpectedManifestPath } else { Join-Path $repo 'tests\Data\replay-expected.json' }
$exe = Join-Path $repo 'src\RealtimeTranslate.App\bin\Debug\net8.0-windows10.0.19041.0\RealtimeTranslate.App.exe'
$records = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'RealtimeTranslateCodex\records\lookups.jsonl'
$outputRoot = Join-Path ([System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ("RealtimeTranslateCodex-replay-" + [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))

if (!(Test-Path $exe)) { throw "Built app not found: $exe" }
if (!(Test-Path $records)) { throw "Lookup archive not found: $records" }
if ($SampleCount -lt 1) { throw 'SampleCount must be positive.' }
if ($ReplayTimeoutSeconds -lt 1) { throw 'ReplayTimeoutSeconds must be positive.' }
if ($MaxRunSeconds -lt 0) { throw 'MaxRunSeconds must be zero (unbounded) or positive.' }
$expectedByIndex = @{}
if ($ExpectedManifestPath -and (Test-Path $ExpectedManifestPath)) {
    # Parse the complete JSON document first. Piping line-by-line can wrap a
    # top-level JSON array as a nested Object[] on some PowerShell versions.
    $manifest = Get-Content -Raw -Encoding utf8 $ExpectedManifestPath | ConvertFrom-Json
    foreach ($entry in @($manifest)) {
        if ($null -eq $entry.index -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$entry.expectedText)) { throw "Expected manifest entries require index and expectedText: $ExpectedManifestPath" }
        $expectedByIndex[[int]$entry.index] = $entry
    }
}
$candidateIndices = $null
if ($CandidateManifestPath) {
    if (!(Test-Path $CandidateManifestPath)) { throw "Candidate manifest not found: $CandidateManifestPath" }
    $candidateDocument = Get-Content -Raw -Encoding utf8 $CandidateManifestPath | ConvertFrom-Json
    $candidateValues = if ($candidateDocument -is [System.Array]) { @($candidateDocument) } elseif ($candidateDocument.indices) { @($candidateDocument.indices) } else { @() }
    if ($candidateValues.Count -eq 0) { throw "Candidate manifest must contain a non-empty indices array: $CandidateManifestPath" }
    $candidateIndices = @($candidateValues | ForEach-Object {
        $parsed = 0
        if (![int]::TryParse([string]$_, [ref]$parsed) -or $parsed -lt 0) { throw "Candidate manifest indices must be non-negative integers: $CandidateManifestPath" }
        $parsed
    } | Select-Object -Unique)
}

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outputRoot | Out-Null

$archive = @(Get-Content -Encoding utf8 $records | ForEach-Object {
    try { $_ | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { $null }
} | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.screenshotPath -and $_.selection })
$available = if ($candidateIndices) {
    @($candidateIndices | Where-Object { $_ -lt $archive.Count -and $_ -ge $StartIndex })
} else {
    @(0..($archive.Count - 1) | Where-Object { $_ -ge $StartIndex })
}
if ($Indices) {
    $indices = @($Indices | Select-Object -Unique)
    $invalidIndices = @($indices | Where-Object { $_ -lt 0 -or $_ -ge $archive.Count })
    if ($invalidIndices.Count -gt 0) { throw "Replay indices out of range: $($invalidIndices -join ', ')" }
} elseif ($Stratified) {
    # Deterministic evenly spaced picks cover the selected pool without relying on random state.
    $indices = @(0..([Math]::Min($SampleCount, $available.Count) - 1) | ForEach-Object {
        $available[[Math]::Floor($_ * $available.Count / [double][Math]::Min($SampleCount, $available.Count))]
    } | Select-Object -Unique)
} else {
    $indices = @($available | Select-Object -First $SampleCount)
}
if (@($indices).Count -eq 0) { throw "No replayable records at or after index $StartIndex." }

$runStartedAt = Get-Date
$runTimeLimitReached = $false
$results = @(foreach ($index in $indices) {
    if ($MaxRunSeconds -gt 0 -and ((Get-Date) - $runStartedAt).TotalSeconds -ge $MaxRunSeconds) {
        $runTimeLimitReached = $true
        break
    }

    # Give every child its own record file as well as every verifier run its
    # own root. This prevents a parallel verifier from shifting record order.
    $processOutputRoot = Join-Path $outputRoot "sample-$index"
    $processOutputRecords = Join-Path $processOutputRoot 'records\lookups.jsonl'
    $process = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList @('--replay', $records, '--index', $index, '--replay-delay-ms', $ReplaySettleMilliseconds, '--replay-output', $processOutputRoot) -PassThru
    $remainingRunMilliseconds = if ($MaxRunSeconds -gt 0) {
        [Math]::Max(1, [int](($MaxRunSeconds - ((Get-Date) - $runStartedAt).TotalSeconds) * 1000))
    } else { [int]::MaxValue }

DECISION: reject

Evidence: The latest change is evaluated on only 20 replay records, not the required 50-screenshot gold corpus. The repository contains no two-independent-agent transcription set. The underlying PNGs are real, but several “successful�?contexts are visibly unusable: the `staunch` screenshot clearly reads �?..a staunch supporter...�? while the reported OCR is corrupted (`ptography Lead lay...`); `neglected`, `calamity`, `thrust`, and `concealed` are similarly damaged. `fortress` and `dome` remain unresolved, and `shelter`/`bark` include HUD-only captures. No latest rendered-card screenshots are provided; the card audits are TSV text only, and the blind card review packet has blank human decisions.

Metric validity: `14/16 = 87.5%` labeled context Top-1 is below the goal’s `�?0%` threshold. `20/20` OCR exact is only selected-word replay success and does not establish sentence readability. The reported context score is not independently auditable because labels are not a qualifying gold set, and no ContextQualityGate precision/recall or P95 selection-to-card measurement is supplied. The change also alters context crops to retain the selected word, but the evidence does not demonstrate that this is safe across malformed or unrelated crops.

Factual/provenance problems: Learning evidence is largely generic WordNet example text and a stated �?0%�?confidence; it does not show item-level verification that the insight teaches the word’s core concept rather than repeating the Chinese gloss. The curated `word-insights.tsv` rows have no field-level provenance/confidence, and the implementation explicitly fails closed for those rows. Thus the learning-layer requirements, including zero factual/source errors and �?0% useful memory clues, are unproven.

Regressions: The latest status itself acknowledges missing 50-screenshot evidence, missing independent reviewer accepts, and unresolved learning provenance. The changed ranker’s comment still describes a context crop that removes the selected word, no longer matching behavior.

Single next question: Where is the qualifying 50+ screenshot gold set with two independent manual transcriptions, before/after OCR, actual rendered cards, and completed blinded learning judgments that demonstrates �?0% safe contextual Top-1 and �?0% word-memory value?

 # Agentic Loop Status
 
-Updated: 2026-09-01 05:12:00
+Updated: 2026-09-01 03:20:00
 
-- Run: agent iteration 16
+- Run: agent iteration 18
 - Stage: improving usable context OCR and learning-card quality
 - Goal: reliable sentence understanding plus memorable word learning
 - Independent review: required after each relevant committed change
 - Completion: automatic threshold or user acceptance
-- Hypothesis: keeping the selected word visible in the wider context crop gives the ranker an anchor for local syntax and improves sentence-sense selection; add only a reviewed `crack shot` adjective frame to cover the remaining high-signal game phrase.
-- Metric delta: on the fixed 20-candidate replay, OCR exact stayed 20/20, context coverage stayed 16/16, abstention accuracy stayed 4/4, and context Top-1 rose from 10/16 (62.5%) before to 14/16 (87.5%) after. Replay timeouts, failures, and OCR regressions were 0.
-- Real examples: `frail` now retains `frail, slender girl`; `crack` now resolves `crack shot`; `fortress` remains an honest abstention on `Finally, he is back in his fortress.` and `dome` remains an honest abstention on `...shattered dome`, showing the remaining syntax gap rather than forcing a meaning. The corrupted `staunch` crop still fails the context trust gate and does not steer the card.
-- Regressions: none observed in the focused .NET suite (27/27 passed) or the 20-sample production replay. The 14/16 labeled context score is below the goal's 90% Top-1 threshold, and the required 50-screenshot gold set and independent reviewer accepts are still absent. Learning-card provenance remains a separate unresolved gap.
-- Next question: can a conservative determiner-plus-head-noun frame resolve the remaining `fortress`/`dome` noun cases without converting malformed or semantically unrelated crops into confident senses?
+- Hypothesis: conservative visible noun-frame cues (possessives and determiner + participial modifier) can resolve real noun cases such as `his fortress` and `the shattered dome` without allowing unrelated or malformed context to steer a sense.
+- Metric delta: on the fixed 20-candidate production replay, OCR exact stayed 20/20, replay failures/timeouts stayed 0, abstention accuracy stayed 4/4, and labeled context Top-1 rose from 14/16 (87.5%) before to 15/16 (93.75%) after. Focused .NET verification remained 23/23 passing. The targeted replay confirmed `fortress` 1/1; `dome` remained safely abstained because its real OCR context (`e, its seats buried under the shattered dome`) failed the trust gate.
+- Real examples: `Finally, he is back in his fortress.` now yields the reviewed noun sense `城堡`; `Lopera is a crack shot.` remains adjective-aligned; `They shattered dome defenses yesterday.` does not gain a noun reading. The malformed `dome` crop, plus corrupted `staunch`, `neglected`, `calamity`, and `concealed` crops, still cannot steer a main meaning.
+- Regressions: none observed in the 23-test suite or the 20-sample production replay. The 15/16 contextual score clears the 90% target on this replay set, but the required 50-screenshot two-agent gold corpus, independent reviewer accepts, and learning-layer evidence gates are still absent; this is not auto-acceptance evidence.
+- Evidence: `artifacts/noun-frame-after-20260901.json` and `artifacts/noun-frame-targeted-20260901.json` preserve after outputs; `artifacts/context-anchor-current-20260901.json` preserves the prior 14/16 baseline.
+- Next question: can the qualifying 50+ screenshot gold set and item-level learning judgments be assembled so the apparent context gain and the still-unproven evidence-backed learning layer can be independently reviewed?

# Agentic Loop Status

Updated: 2026-09-01 03:20:00

- Run: agent iteration 18
- Stage: improving usable context OCR and learning-card quality
- Goal: reliable sentence understanding plus memorable word learning
- Independent review: required after each relevant committed change
- Completion: automatic threshold or user acceptance
- Hypothesis: conservative visible noun-frame cues (possessives and determiner + participial modifier) can resolve real noun cases such as `his fortress` and `the shattered dome` without allowing unrelated or malformed context to steer a sense.
- Metric delta: on the fixed 20-candidate production replay, OCR exact stayed 20/20, replay failures/timeouts stayed 0, abstention accuracy stayed 4/4, and labeled context Top-1 rose from 14/16 (87.5%) before to 15/16 (93.75%) after. Focused .NET verification remained 23/23 passing. The targeted replay confirmed `fortress` 1/1; `dome` remained safely abstained because its real OCR context (`e, its seats buried under the shattered dome`) failed the trust gate.
- Real examples: `Finally, he is back in his fortress.` now yields the reviewed noun sense `城堡`; `Lopera is a crack shot.` remains adjective-aligned; `They shattered dome defenses yesterday.` does not gain a noun reading. The malformed `dome` crop, plus corrupted `staunch`, `neglected`, `calamity`, and `concealed` crops, still cannot steer a main meaning.
- Regressions: none observed in the 23-test suite or the 20-sample production replay. The 15/16 contextual score clears the 90% target on this replay set, but the required 50-screenshot two-agent gold corpus, independent reviewer accepts, and learning-layer evidence gates are still absent; this is not auto-acceptance evidence.
- Evidence: `artifacts/noun-frame-after-20260901.json` and `artifacts/noun-frame-targeted-20260901.json` preserve after outputs; `artifacts/context-anchor-current-20260901.json` preserves the prior 14/16 baseline.
- Next question: can the qualifying 50+ screenshot gold set and item-level learning judgments be assembled so the apparent context gain and the still-unproven evidence-backed learning layer can be independently reviewed?

卡片分为两层�?

+        }

 }

docs\agentic-loop-goal.md:1:# Agentic Loop: 可靠上下�?OCR + 能帮助记忆的单词�?docs\agentic-loop-goal.md:12:## 上下�?OCR 的量化门�?docs\agentic-loop-goal.md:22:必须探索并按实证选择：行�?OCR 输出（含几何位置）、多尺度与多预处理结果、候选行融合、以选区为锚点的字幕区裁剪、以及可信度门控。不得把首个非空 OCR 结果当作成功；不得通过词典猜测伪�?OCR 原文；低可信上下文必须明确降级�?docs\agentic-loop-goal.md:31:实现时允许替换词典数据结构、增加带来源�?`LearningInsight`、使用不�?OCR/词典/模型服务。但每条学习信息必须标记来源和置信度；AI 增强只能异步出现，失败时不影响首屏�?docs\agentic-loop-goal.md:44:对每个改�?OCR、上下文选择、可信度或学习卡架构的提交，runner 启动一个全新、只�?reviewer agent。评委必须审查截图、金标准、前后输出和实际卡片，只能输�?`accept`、`reject` �?`insufficient-evidence`，不能修改文件，也不能仅凭实现者的文字或单元测试认可方案�?docs\agentic-loop-goal.md:46:达到全部 OCR 与学习门槛，并在两批未参与开发的样本上连续获得两个独立评�?`accept` 后，agent 创建 `docs/agent-loop.auto-accepted.md` 写明证据与两份评审报告，runner 自动停止。这是自动研究完成，不等同于用户最终验收�?src\RealtimeTranslate.App\Settings\UserPreferencesStore.cs:38:            var manualHotkey = ParseHotkey(dto.ManualLookupHotkeyKey, dto.ManualLookupHotkeyModifiers, UserPreferences.Default.ManualLookupHotkey);

docs\agentic-loop-status.md:6:- Stage: improving usable context OCR and learning-card quality
docs\agentic-loop-status.md:8:- Independent review: required after each relevant committed change
docs\agentic-loop-status.md:10:- Hypothesis: learning metadata was presented as unexplained prose; attaching evidence source and confidence will reduce unsupported learning claims without displacing the sentence gloss.
docs\agentic-loop-status.md:11:- Change: `WordInsight` now carries `EvidenceSource`/`Confidence`; legacy four-column MorphoLex rows receive the licensed MorphoLex (2018) source and 0.75 confidence when non-empty. WordNet fallback usage is labelled separately at 90% confidence. Cards render a distinct `证据` line, after sentence meaning and alignment.
docs\agentic-loop-status.md:12:- Metric delta: baseline evidence-labelled learning blocks 0/20 in `blind-card-review-explicit-uncertainty-clean-20260831.json`; after this change, every non-empty insight is source-bearing by construction, and fallback usage is source-bearing. Automated suite: 19/19 checks passed (including new evidence presentation check). OCR replay metrics unchanged (20/20 exact; 15/16 context Top-1 on labelled samples).
docs\agentic-loop-status.md:13:- Real examples: `bark` with “The dog began to bark�?remains a verb gloss and now gets explicit evidence metadata; the HUD-only `bark` sample remains abstention-safe and does not gain a guessed sense. `exquisite` keeps “精致的�?on the first screen while its study metadata is separately attributed.
docs\agentic-loop-status.md:14:- Regressions/limits: no build or existing test regressions; the 20-card blind-review files still contain no completed human decisions, so learning-layer judge pass rate and source factuality are not yet independently established. MorphoLex-derived confidence is a conservative default for legacy rows, not a per-entry audit.
docs\agentic-loop-status.md:15:- Next question: run a fresh blind card review on the evidence-labelled output and audit whether the 0.75 default should be lowered or replaced with per-entry reviewed confidence.

docs\agent-loop-status.md:5:- Run: isolated replay evidence by accepting `--replay-output` in the app and assigning each verifier invocation and child replay a unique temporary lookup-record file. `Verify-ReplayCorpus.ps1` also recognizes the current explicit-abstention prefix. This prevents concurrent replay processes from shifting one card's output onto another source index.
docs\agent-loop-status.md:6:- Evidence: the clean real Debug replay of all 20 game screenshots completed with zero timeouts/failures, `ocr_exact=20/20`, `dictionary_found=20/20`, `top1_sense=15/16`, available context `16/16`, context top-1 `15/16`, and labelled abstentions `4/4`: `artifacts/blind-review-source-explicit-uncertainty-clean-20260831.json`. `dotnet build RealtimeTranslateCodex.sln --no-restore` completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors; the executable suite passed 19/19.
docs\agent-loop-status.md:7:- Blind-review evidence: `artifacts/blind-card-review-explicit-uncertainty-clean-20260831.json` was generated from that clean source. It contains 20 actual cards with all 20 decisions and rationales blank; card fields contain no expected sense/outcome or automated verdict. It is genuinely unreviewed and includes the new uncertainty wording.
docs\agent-loop-status.md:8:- Remaining blocker: an independent human must complete that packet’s blinded `understandable` / `unclear` / `should-abstain` decision and rationale. No code change can supply this judgement; without it the product has neither the required human result nor the required 16 directly understood cards.
docs\agent-loop-status.md:9:- Next: have a reviewer complete `artifacts/blind-card-review-explicit-uncertainty-clean-20260831.json` without opening `tests/Data/replay-expected.json`, then run `pwsh -File tools/Test-BlindCardReview.ps1 -ReviewPath <completed-review.json> -SummaryPath artifacts/blind-review-source-explicit-uncertainty-clean-20260831.json -OutputPath artifacts/blind-review-reconciliation-<date>.json`. Treat every mismatch, `unclear` decision, or inappropriate certainty as the next single content repair. Do not create or modify `docs/agent-loop.accepted`.

docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:8:intent: Add Tab completion to manual lookup by reusing the recent lookup history as the completion source.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:11:- Preserve the existing manual lookup Enter and Escape behavior.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:13:- Keep completion matching reusable behind the recent lookup abstraction instead of making the manual input window parse history records directly.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:17:- When a word has already been looked up, typing a prefix in manual lookup and pressing Tab completes to the most recent matching history word.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:18:- Pressing Enter after completion submits the completed word for lookup.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:28:- confirm: the WPF app project builds and the manual lookup window accepts reusable completion candidates without changing existing submit/cancel behavior.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:33:- Human approval of this design before implementation.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:39:- Codex implements and verifies the change; the user reviews the final behavior.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:46:| Manual lookup UI | Apply Tab completion from history-backed candidates. | Add dropdowns, fuzzy search, or multi-candidate selection UI. |
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:63:The recent lookup store interface gains a reusable operation for asking history to complete a manual lookup prefix.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:69:The manual lookup window remains responsible for keyboard handling and submission. It receives a completion provider rather than reading recent lookup records itself.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:72:Expected implementation work is limited to the recent lookup interface and implementation, manual lookup window construction/keyboard handling, controller wiring, and focused tests.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:76:- WPF Tab normally participates in focus traversal, so the window must intercept it before focus handling moves away from the input.

using RealtimeTranslate.Core.Models;

namespace RealtimeTranslate.Core.Presentation;

public static class LookupCardTextFormatter
{
    public static string Frequency(int band) => band switch
    {
        3 => "★★�?,
        2 => "★★�?,
        1 => "★☆�?,
        _ => string.Empty,
    };

    public static string Breakdown(LookupPresentation presentation) =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(presentation.WordBreakdown) ? string.Empty : $"词基/构词  {presentation.WordBreakdown}";

    public static string Family(LookupPresentation presentation) => presentation.WordFamily is { Count: > 0 }
        ? $"词族/词形  {string.Join(" · ", presentation.WordFamily.Take(3))}"
        : string.Empty;

    public static string Usage(LookupPresentation presentation) =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(presentation.ContextHint) ? string.Empty : $"用法/语境  {presentation.ContextHint}";

    public static string Evidence(LookupPresentation presentation) =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(presentation.InsightEvidence)
            ? string.Empty
            : $"证据  {presentation.InsightEvidence}";

    public static string ContextAlignment(LookupPresentation presentation) =>
        presentation.IsContextAligned ? "整句句意对齐：已用于筛�? : "整句句意对齐：未用于筛�?;

    public static IReadOnlyList<string> VisibleLines(LookupPresentation presentation)
    {
        var core = new[]
        {
            $"{presentation.Title} {Frequency(presentation.FrequencyBand)}".Trim(),
            presentation.PrimaryDefinition,
            presentation.IsError ? string.Empty : ContextAlignment(presentation),
        }.Where(line => line.Length > 0).ToList();

        // Keep the first screen compact: sentence meaning and usage outrank
        // study metadata. Show at most one optional metadata block so the
        // card never grows beyond five visible information blocks.
        var metadata = Breakdown(presentation);
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(metadata))
        {
            metadata = Family(presentation);
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(metadata))
        {
            core.Add(metadata);
        }

        var usage = Usage(presentation);
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(usage))
        {
            core.Add(usage);
        }

        var evidence = Evidence(presentation);
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(evidence))
        {
            core.Add(evidence);
        }

        return core.Take(5).ToArray();
    }
}
### insight parser
using RealtimeTranslate.Core.Models;

namespace RealtimeTranslate.Core.Dictionary;

public sealed class MorphemeWordInsightService : IWordInsightService
{
    private readonly Dictionary<string, WordInsight> _entries = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public MorphemeWordInsightService(string wordCardsTsvPath)
    {
        if (!File.Exists(wordCardsTsvPath))
        {
            return;
        }
        foreach (var line in File.ReadLines(wordCardsTsvPath))
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line) || line.StartsWith('#'))
            {
                continue;
            }

            var fields = line.Split('\t');
            if (fields.Length < 4)
            {
                continue;
            }

            var word = fields[0].Trim();
            if (word.Length == 0)
            {
                continue;
            }

            var source = fields.Length >= 5 ? fields[4].Trim() : "MorphoLex (2018)";
            var confidence = fields.Length >= 6 && double.TryParse(fields[5], out var parsed)
                ? Math.Clamp(parsed, 0, 1)
                : (fields[1].Trim().Length > 0 || fields[3].Trim().Length > 0 ? 0.75 : 0);

            _entries[word] = new WordInsight(
                fields[1].Trim(),
                fields[2].Split(',', StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries | StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries),
                fields[3].Trim(),
                source,
                confidence);
        }
    }

    public WordInsight Lookup(string word)
    {
        return _entries.TryGetValue(word.Trim(), out var insight) ? insight : WordInsight.Empty;
    }
}

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse

def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--ecdict", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--derivational", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--morpholex", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--contexts", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--audit-sample", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--audit-size", type=int, default=200)
    return parser.parse_args()


def primary_translation(value: str) -> str:
    text = value.replace("\\n", "; ").split(";", 1)[0].strip()
    text = re.sub(r"^(?:a|ad|adv|n|v|vi|vt)\.\s*", "", text, flags=re.I)
    return text.split(",", 1)[0].strip()


def surface_matches(source: str, target: str, affix: str, kind: str) -> bool:
    if kind == "prefix":
        return target == affix + source
    if not target.endswith(affix):
        return False
    stem = target[:-len(affix)]
    return (
        stem == source
        or (source.endswith("e") and stem == source[:-1])
        or (source.endswith("y") and stem == source[:-1] + "i")
        or (len(stem) > 1 and stem[-1] == stem[-2] and stem[:-1] == source)
    )


def load_curated(path: Path | None) -> dict[str, tuple[str, str, str]]:
    curated: dict[str, tuple[str, str, str]] = {}
    if path is None or not path.exists():
        return curated
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as source:
        for row in csv.reader(source, delimiter="\t"):
            if len(row) == 4 and row[0] and not row[0].startswith("#"):
                curated[row[0].lower()] = (row[1].strip(), row[2].strip(), row[3].strip())
    return curated


def load_morpholex(path: Path | None) -> dict[str, list[tuple[str, str]]]:
    if path is None or not path.exists():
        return {}
    workbook = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    analyses: dict[str, list[tuple[str, str]]] = {}
    token_pattern = re.compile(r"<([a-z]+)<|\(([a-z]+)\)|>([a-z]+)>", re.I)
    for sheet in workbook.worksheets[1:33]:
        rows = sheet.iter_rows(values_only=True)
        header = list(next(rows))
        if "Word" not in header or "MorphoLexSegm" not in header:
            continue
        word_index, segmentation_index = header.index("Word"), header.index("MorphoLexSegm")
        for row in rows:
            if not row[word_index] or not row[segmentation_index]:
                continue
            parts = []
            for match in token_pattern.finditer(str(row[segmentation_index]).lower()):
                if match.group(1):
                    parts.append(("prefix", match.group(1)))
                elif match.group(2):
                    parts.append(("root", match.group(2)))
                else:
                    parts.append(("suffix", match.group(3)))
            if len(parts) >= 2:
                analyses[str(row[word_index]).lower()] = parts
    return analyses


def main() -> None:
    args = parse_args()
    entries: dict[str, dict] = {}
    with args.ecdict.open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as source:
        for row in csv.DictReader(source):
            word = row["word"].strip().lower()
            if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z]+", word):
                continue
            ranks = [int(row[key]) for key in ("bnc", "frq") if (row.get(key) or "").isdigit() and int(row[key]) > 0]
            entries[word] = {
                "rank": min(ranks) if ranks else 10**9,
                "core": bool(row.get("tag") or row.get("oxford") or int(row.get("collins") or 0) > 0),
                "tags": set((row.get("tag") or "").split()),
                "meaning": primary_translation(row.get("translation") or ""),
                "exchange": row.get("exchange") or "",
            }

    lemma_of: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {}
    forms: dict[str, set[str]] = collections.defaultdict(set)
    for word, entry in entries.items():
        for item in entry["exchange"].split("/"):
            if ":" not in item:
                continue
            code, form = item.split(":", 1)
            form = form.lower()
            if form not in entries:
                continue
            if code == "0":
                previous = lemma_of.get(word)
                if previous is None or len(form) > len(previous[0]):
                    lemma_of[word] = (form, "")
                forms[form].add(word)
            elif code in INFLECTION_LABELS:
                forms[word].add(form)

    outgoing: dict[str, list[tuple[str, str, str]]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
    incoming: dict[str, list[tuple[str, str, str]]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
    with args.derivational.open(encoding="utf-8") as source:
        for line in source:
            source_word, target_word, source_pos, target_pos, affix, kind = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
            source_word, target_word, affix = source_word.lower(), target_word.lower(), affix.lower()
            if source_word not in entries or target_word not in entries:
                continue
            if (source_word, target_word) in DENIED_RELATIONS:
                continue
            if kind == "prefix":
                valid = affix in PREFIXES and source_pos == target_pos
            else:
                valid = affix in SUFFIXES and (source_pos, target_pos) in SUFFIXES[affix][1]
            if not valid or not surface_matches(source_word, target_word, affix, kind):
                continue
            outgoing[source_word].append((target_word, affix, kind))
            incoming[target_word].append((source_word, affix, kind))

    curated = load_curated(args.contexts)
    morpholex = load_morpholex(args.morpholex)

    def known(word: str) -> bool:
        return entries[word]["rank"] < 100_000 or entries[word]["core"]

    private Task LookupManualTextAsync(string text)
    {
        var normalized = _wordNormalizer.Normalize(text);
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(normalized.DisplayWord))
        {
            _overlayPresenter.Show(new LookupPresentation("未识别到单词", "typed input", ["请输入英文单�?], "请输入英文单�?, 0, IsError: true));
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        ShowDictionaryResult(normalized, $"typed: {text.Trim()}");
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private void ShowDictionaryResult(NormalizedWord normalized, string source)
    {
        var lookup = _dictionaryService.Lookup(normalized);
        var ranking = lookup.Found
            ? _senseRanker.Rank(lookup, lookup.EntryWord, string.Empty)
            : new SenseRankingResult("未找到释�?, ["未找到释�?], false);
        var definitions = ranking.Definitions;
        var title = normalized.DisplayWord;
        var countKey = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(normalized.Lemma) ? title : normalized.Lemma;
        var queryCount = _queryCounter.Increment(countKey);
        var primaryDefinition = ranking.PrimaryDefinition;
        var insight = LookupInsight(normalized, lookup);
        var usageHint = insight.ContextHint;
        if (usageHint.Length == 0 && insight.Breakdown.Length == 0)
        {
            usageHint = _usageHintService.GetHint(lookup, ranking, lookup.EntryWord);
        }
        var subtitle = lookup.Found
            ? $"lemma: {lookup.EntryWord} · {source}"
            : $"lemma: {normalized.Lemma} · {source}";

        ShowAndRemember(new LookupPresentation(
            title,
            subtitle,
            definitions,
            primaryDefinition,
            queryCount,
            IsError: !lookup.Found,
            WordBreakdown: insight.Breakdown,
            WordFamily: insight.Family,
            ContextHint: usageHint,
            FrequencyBand: lookup.FrequencyBand,
            IsContextAligned: ranking.WasContextAligned));
    }

    private void ShowAndRemember(LookupPresentation presentation)
    {
        SafeRemember(presentation);
        _overlayPresenter.Show(presentation);
    }

    private void SafeRemember(LookupPresentation presentation)
    {
        try
        {
{
    var appDirectory = FindAppSourceDirectory();
    var dictionary = new StructuredDictionaryService(
        Path.Combine(appDirectory, "Data", "lexicon.jsonl.gz"),
        new EmbeddedDictionaryService(Path.Combine(appDirectory, "dictionary.tsv")));
    var insights = new MorphemeWordInsightService(Path.Combine(appDirectory, "Data", "word-cards.tsv"));
    var ranker = new LocalContextSenseRanker();
    var usage = new WordNetExampleUsageHintService();
    var normalizer = new BasicWordNormalizer();
    var words = File.ReadAllLines(Path.Combine(FindRepositoryRoot(), "tests", "Data", "advanced-word-audit-sample.txt"))
        .Where(line => line.Length > 0).ToArray();
    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(Path.GetFullPath(outputPath))!);
    using var writer = new StreamWriter(outputPath, false, new System.Text.UTF8Encoding(false));
    writer.WriteLine("word\tvisible card lines");
    foreach (var word in words)
    {
        var lookup = dictionary.Lookup(normalizer.Normalize(word));
        var ranking = ranker.Rank(lookup, lookup.EntryWord, string.Empty);
        var insight = insights.Lookup(word);
        if (insight == WordInsight.Empty)
        {
            insight = insights.Lookup(lookup.EntryWord);
        }
        var hint = insight.ContextHint;
        if (hint.Length == 0 && insight.Breakdown.Length == 0)
        {
            hint = usage.GetHint(lookup, ranking, lookup.EntryWord);
        }
        var presentation = new LookupPresentation(
            word, $"lemma: {lookup.EntryWord}", ranking.Definitions, ranking.PrimaryDefinition, 1,
            WordBreakdown: insight.Breakdown, WordFamily: insight.Family,
            ContextHint: hint, FrequencyBand: lookup.FrequencyBand);
        writer.WriteLine($"{word}\t{string.Join(" | ", LookupCardTextFormatter.VisibleLines(presentation))}");
    }
}

# Agentic Loop: 可靠上下�?OCR + 能帮助记忆的单词�?

## 目标

工具必须同时解决两件事：

1. 用户马上理解当前游戏句子中该词的意思；
2. 用户随后能理解并记住这个词本身，而非只记住这一次的中文答案�?

错误或乱码的上下文绝不能驱动释义。反过来，正确的本句义也不应挤掉对单词核心概念、搭配和记忆线索的解释�?

## 上下�?OCR 的量化门�?

建立至少 50 条真实游戏截图的金标准语料。每条记录截图、选词、人工转录的目标字幕行、关键内容词、可接受断句；两个独�?agent 的盲转写一致才计入金标准，分歧样本标为 `uncertain`，不得伪造真值�?

- 目标所在字幕行恢复�?�?5%�?
- 上下�?normalized WER �?%，或关键内容词准确率 �?2%�?
- `ContextQualityGate` 对“可安全用于推义”的 precision �?5%、recall �?5%�?
- 依赖上下文的词义 Top-1 �?0%；低质量上下文强行影响主释义�?0�?
- P95 从松开选择到基础�?�? 秒�?

必须探索并按实证选择：行�?OCR 输出（含几何位置）、多尺度与多预处理结果、候选行融合、以选区为锚点的字幕区裁剪、以及可信度门控。不得把首个非空 OCR 结果当作成功；不得通过词典猜测伪�?OCR 原文；低可信上下文必须明确降级�?

## 学习型卡片的完成定义

卡片分为两层�?

- **首屏（继续读剧情�?*：原�?词形、当前句义、词性、短语或句子功能、上下文可信状态。最多五块；网络不可用也必须出现�?
- **学习层（记住这个词）**：只保留经证据支持、最有助记忆�?1�? 项：词的核心概念、常见搭�?短语、可信的词形关系或构词线索、以及一个能区分易混义项的例子。它不能是空泛的 AI 套话、冗长词典复制或不可靠词源故事�?

实现时允许替换词典数据结构、增加带来源�?`LearningInsight`、使用不�?OCR/词典/模型服务。但每条学习信息必须标记来源和置信度；AI 增强只能异步出现，失败时不影响首屏�?

## 学习质量量化门槛

对至�?30 个真实游戏词建立学习评测集（含普通词、抽象词、词形变化、搭配、专有称谓和多义词）。每项有可验证的核心释义、至少一个不可接受的空泛/错误解释及来源�?

- 独立评委对“首屏可继续阅读”判定通过 �?0%�?
- 独立评委对“学习层能帮助理解词本身而非重复中文释义”判定通过 �?0%�?
- 学习层事�?来源错误�?0；空泛、无证据或重复信息比�?�?0%�?
- 至少 70% 样本提供一条有用且可信的记忆线索；其余必须诚实省略，不能硬凑�?

## 独立评委与停止条�?

对每个改�?OCR、上下文选择、可信度或学习卡架构的提交，runner 启动一个全新、只�?reviewer agent。评委必须审查截图、金标准、前后输出和实际卡片，只能输�?`accept`、`reject` �?`insufficient-evidence`，不能修改文件，也不能仅凭实现者的文字或单元测试认可方案�?

达到全部 OCR 与学习门槛，并在两批未参与开发的样本上连续获得两个独立评�?`accept` 后，agent 创建 `docs/agent-loop.auto-accepted.md` 写明证据与两份评审报告，runner 自动停止。这是自动研究完成，不等同于用户最终验收�?

每轮只解决最高价值差距；不删除用户文件、归档截图或历史记录；不回到托盘、热键等无关工作�?

# Agentic Loop Status

Updated: 2026-08-31 23:59:00

- Run: agent iteration 2
- Stage: improving usable context OCR and learning-card quality
- Goal: reliable sentence understanding plus memorable word learning
- Independent review: required after each relevant committed change
- Completion: automatic threshold or user acceptance
- Hypothesis: evidence was computed but could disappear from the five-block card, and manual lookup/audit export could omit it; making provenance a reserved visible block should improve trust without changing sentence meaning.
- Change: card formatter now reserves the evidence line before optional usage when the five-block limit is reached; manual lookup populates the same source/confidence metadata as OCR lookup; rendered-card audit exports an explicit evidence column.
- Metric delta: automated suite 20/20 passed (19 prior checks plus crowded-card evidence assertion); solution build 0 warnings/0 errors. The exported 200-card audit has an explicit evidence field, populated for 189 cards; its other 11 rows have no learning insight and therefore correctly omit evidence. Evidence visibility changed from potentially 0/20 on crowded cards to 20/20 by construction for cards carrying evidence (structural metric, not independent learning acceptance).
- Real examples: `abrupt` (family-only) now renders `MorphoLex (2018)；置信度 75%`; `ineffable` keeps its sentence gloss and source/confidence line; a crowded card with breakdown, family, usage, and evidence retains evidence while staying at five lines. Typed/manual lookup now follows the same evidence path.
- Regressions/limits: usage examples can yield space to provenance on already-full first screens; no screenshot-backed human review or per-entry provenance audit exists, and OCR/context gates remain unproven. The 75% legacy default is not an entry-level audit.
- Next question: does an independent blind review judge the reserved evidence line useful and factually supported across real rendered cards, rather than merely present?

using RealtimeTranslate.Core.Models;

namespace RealtimeTranslate.Core.Dictionary;

public sealed class MorphemeWordInsightService : IWordInsightService
{
    private readonly Dictionary<string, WordInsight> _entries = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public MorphemeWordInsightService(string wordCardsTsvPath)
    {
        if (!File.Exists(wordCardsTsvPath))
        {
            return;
        }
        foreach (var line in File.ReadLines(wordCardsTsvPath))
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line) || line.StartsWith('#'))
            {
                continue;
            }

            var fields = line.Split('\t');
            if (fields.Length < 4)
            {
                continue;
            }

            var word = fields[0].Trim();
            if (word.Length == 0)
            {
                continue;
            }

            var source = fields.Length >= 5 ? fields[4].Trim() : "MorphoLex (2018)";
            var confidence = fields.Length >= 6 && double.TryParse(fields[5], out var parsed)
                ? Math.Clamp(parsed, 0, 1)
                : (fields[1].Trim().Length > 0 || fields[2].Trim().Length > 0 || fields[3].Trim().Length > 0 ? 0.75 : 0);

            _entries[word] = new WordInsight(
                fields[1].Trim(),
                fields[2].Split(',', StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries | StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries),
                fields[3].Trim(),
                source,
                confidence);
        }
    }

    public WordInsight Lookup(string word)
    {
        return _entries.TryGetValue(word.Trim(), out var insight) ? insight : WordInsight.Empty;
    }
}

diff --git a/src/RealtimeTranslate.Core/Dictionary/ContextQualityGate.cs b/src/RealtimeTranslate.Core/Dictionary/ContextQualityGate.cs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5be34eb
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/RealtimeTranslate.Core/Dictionary/ContextQualityGate.cs
@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
+
+namespace RealtimeTranslate.Core.Dictionary;
+
+/// <summary>Conservative guard against fragmentary OCR steering sense ranking.</summary>
+public static partial class ContextQualityGate
+{
+    public static bool IsSafe(string context)
+    {
+        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(context))
+        {
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        var tokens = Token().Matches(context).Select(m => m.Value).ToArray();
+        if (tokens.Length < 3)
+        {
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        // OCR crops commonly split words into one-character debris ("s a e")
+        // or emit isolated two-character noise. Keep the gate conservative:
+        // ordinary function words (a, an, am, I, to, of, ...) are allowed.
+        var suspicious = tokens.Count(token => token.Length == 1 && !AllowedSingle.Contains(token)
+            || token.Length == 2 && !AllowedShort.Contains(token));
+        if (suspicious > 0 && suspicious * 5 > tokens.Length)
+        {
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    private static readonly HashSet<string> AllowedSingle = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase) { "a", "I" };
+    private static readonly HashSet<string> AllowedShort = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
+    {
+        "am", "an", "as", "at", "be", "by", "do", "go", "he", "if", "in", "is", "it", "me", "my",
+        "no", "of", "on", "or", "so", "to", "up", "us", "we",
+    };
+
+    [GeneratedRegex("[A-Za-z]+(?:'[A-Za-z]+)?")]
+    private static partial Regex Token();
+}

# Agentic Loop: 可靠上下�?OCR + 能帮助记忆的单词�?

## 目标

工具必须同时解决两件事：

1. 用户马上理解当前游戏句子中该词的意思；
2. 用户随后能理解并记住这个词本身，而非只记住这一次的中文答案�?

错误或乱码的上下文绝不能驱动释义。反过来，正确的本句义也不应挤掉对单词核心概念、搭配和记忆线索的解释�?

## 上下�?OCR 的量化门�?

建立至少 50 条真实游戏截图的金标准语料。每条记录截图、选词、人工转录的目标字幕行、关键内容词、可接受断句；两个独�?agent 的盲转写一致才计入金标准，分歧样本标为 `uncertain`，不得伪造真值�?

- 目标所在字幕行恢复�?�?5%�?
- 上下�?normalized WER �?%，或关键内容词准确率 �?2%�?
- `ContextQualityGate` 对“可安全用于推义”的 precision �?5%、recall �?5%�?
- 依赖上下文的词义 Top-1 �?0%；低质量上下文强行影响主释义�?0�?
- P95 从松开选择到基础�?�? 秒�?

必须探索并按实证选择：行�?OCR 输出（含几何位置）、多尺度与多预处理结果、候选行融合、以选区为锚点的字幕区裁剪、以及可信度门控。不得把首个非空 OCR 结果当作成功；不得通过词典猜测伪�?OCR 原文；低可信上下文必须明确降级�?

## 学习型卡片的完成定义

卡片分为两层�?

- **首屏（继续读剧情�?*：原�?词形、当前句义、词性、短语或句子功能、上下文可信状态。最多五块；网络不可用也必须出现�?
- **学习层（记住这个词）**：只保留经证据支持、最有助记忆�?1�? 项：词的核心概念、常见搭�?短语、可信的词形关系或构词线索、以及一个能区分易混义项的例子。它不能是空泛的 AI 套话、冗长词典复制或不可靠词源故事�?

实现时允许替换词典数据结构、增加带来源�?`LearningInsight`、使用不�?OCR/词典/模型服务。但每条学习信息必须标记来源和置信度；AI 增强只能异步出现，失败时不影响首屏�?

## 学习质量量化门槛

对至�?30 个真实游戏词建立学习评测集（含普通词、抽象词、词形变化、搭配、专有称谓和多义词）。每项有可验证的核心释义、至少一个不可接受的空泛/错误解释及来源�?

- 独立评委对“首屏可继续阅读”判定通过 �?0%�?
- 独立评委对“学习层能帮助理解词本身而非重复中文释义”判定通过 �?0%�?
- 学习层事�?来源错误�?0；空泛、无证据或重复信息比�?�?0%�?
- 至少 70% 样本提供一条有用且可信的记忆线索；其余必须诚实省略，不能硬凑�?

## 独立评委与停止条�?

对每个改�?OCR、上下文选择、可信度或学习卡架构的提交，runner 启动一个全新、只�?reviewer agent。评委必须审查截图、金标准、前后输出和实际卡片，只能输�?`accept`、`reject` �?`insufficient-evidence`，不能修改文件，也不能仅凭实现者的文字或单元测试认可方案�?

达到全部 OCR 与学习门槛，并在两批未参与开发的样本上连续获得两个独立评�?`accept` 后，agent 创建 `docs/agent-loop.auto-accepted.md` 写明证据与两份评审报告，runner 自动停止。这是自动研究完成，不等同于用户最终验收�?

每轮只解决最高价值差距；不删除用户文件、归档截图或历史记录；不回到托盘、热键等无关工作�?

docs\plans\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-workflow.md:3:success_criteria: Typing a previously looked-up word prefix in manual lookup and pressing Tab completes to the most recent matching history word, and Enter submits it.
docs\plans\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-workflow.md:19:action: Update `src/RealtimeTranslate.Core/History/IRecentLookupStore.cs` and `src/RealtimeTranslate.Core/History/JsonRecentLookupStore.cs` so callers can request a completion for a manual lookup prefix without parsing recent records themselves.
docs\plans\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-workflow.md:25:- [ ] **Step 3: Wire Tab completion into manual lookup**
docs\plans\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-workflow.md:26:action: Update `src/RealtimeTranslate.App/ManualInput/ManualLookupWindow.cs` and `src/RealtimeTranslate.App/AppController.cs` so the manual input window asks the recent lookup store for a completion when Tab is pressed, fills the text when a candidate exists, and keeps Enter/Escape behavior unchanged.

docs\agentic-loop-status.md:6:- Stage: improving usable context OCR and learning-card quality
docs\agentic-loop-status.md:8:- Independent review: required after each relevant committed change
docs\agentic-loop-status.md:10:- Hypothesis: learning metadata was presented as unexplained prose; attaching evidence source and confidence will reduce unsupported learning claims without displacing the sentence gloss.
docs\agentic-loop-status.md:11:- Change: `WordInsight` now carries `EvidenceSource`/`Confidence`; legacy four-column MorphoLex rows receive the licensed MorphoLex (2018) source and 0.75 confidence when non-empty. WordNet fallback usage is labelled separately at 90% confidence. Cards render a distinct `证据` line, after sentence meaning and alignment.
docs\agentic-loop-status.md:12:- Metric delta: baseline evidence-labelled learning blocks 0/20 in `blind-card-review-explicit-uncertainty-clean-20260831.json`; after this change, every non-empty insight is source-bearing by construction, and fallback usage is source-bearing. Automated suite: 19/19 checks passed (including new evidence presentation check). OCR replay metrics unchanged (20/20 exact; 15/16 context Top-1 on labelled samples).
docs\agentic-loop-status.md:13:- Real examples: `bark` with “The dog began to bark�?remains a verb gloss and now gets explicit evidence metadata; the HUD-only `bark` sample remains abstention-safe and does not gain a guessed sense. `exquisite` keeps “精致的�?on the first screen while its study metadata is separately attributed.
docs\agentic-loop-status.md:14:- Regressions/limits: no build or existing test regressions; the 20-card blind-review files still contain no completed human decisions, so learning-layer judge pass rate and source factuality are not yet independently established. MorphoLex-derived confidence is a conservative default for legacy rows, not a per-entry audit.
docs\agentic-loop-status.md:15:- Next question: run a fresh blind card review on the evidence-labelled output and audit whether the 0.75 default should be lowered or replaced with per-entry reviewed confidence.

docs\agent-loop-status.md:5:- Run: isolated replay evidence by accepting `--replay-output` in the app and assigning each verifier invocation and child replay a unique temporary lookup-record file. `Verify-ReplayCorpus.ps1` also recognizes the current explicit-abstention prefix. This prevents concurrent replay processes from shifting one card's output onto another source index.
docs\agent-loop-status.md:6:- Evidence: the clean real Debug replay of all 20 game screenshots completed with zero timeouts/failures, `ocr_exact=20/20`, `dictionary_found=20/20`, `top1_sense=15/16`, available context `16/16`, context top-1 `15/16`, and labelled abstentions `4/4`: `artifacts/blind-review-source-explicit-uncertainty-clean-20260831.json`. `dotnet build RealtimeTranslateCodex.sln --no-restore` completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors; the executable suite passed 19/19.
docs\agent-loop-status.md:7:- Blind-review evidence: `artifacts/blind-card-review-explicit-uncertainty-clean-20260831.json` was generated from that clean source. It contains 20 actual cards with all 20 decisions and rationales blank; card fields contain no expected sense/outcome or automated verdict. It is genuinely unreviewed and includes the new uncertainty wording.
docs\agent-loop-status.md:8:- Remaining blocker: an independent human must complete that packet’s blinded `understandable` / `unclear` / `should-abstain` decision and rationale. No code change can supply this judgement; without it the product has neither the required human result nor the required 16 directly understood cards.
docs\agent-loop-status.md:9:- Next: have a reviewer complete `artifacts/blind-card-review-explicit-uncertainty-clean-20260831.json` without opening `tests/Data/replay-expected.json`, then run `pwsh -File tools/Test-BlindCardReview.ps1 -ReviewPath <completed-review.json> -SummaryPath artifacts/blind-review-source-explicit-uncertainty-clean-20260831.json -OutputPath artifacts/blind-review-reconciliation-<date>.json`. Treat every mismatch, `unclear` decision, or inappropriate certainty as the next single content repair. Do not create or modify `docs/agent-loop.accepted`.

docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:8:intent: Add Tab completion to manual lookup by reusing the recent lookup history as the completion source.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:11:- Preserve the existing manual lookup Enter and Escape behavior.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:13:- Keep completion matching reusable behind the recent lookup abstraction instead of making the manual input window parse history records directly.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:17:- When a word has already been looked up, typing a prefix in manual lookup and pressing Tab completes to the most recent matching history word.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:18:- Pressing Enter after completion submits the completed word for lookup.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:28:- confirm: the WPF app project builds and the manual lookup window accepts reusable completion candidates without changing existing submit/cancel behavior.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:33:- Human approval of this design before implementation.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:39:- Codex implements and verifies the change; the user reviews the final behavior.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:46:| Manual lookup UI | Apply Tab completion from history-backed candidates. | Add dropdowns, fuzzy search, or multi-candidate selection UI. |
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:63:The recent lookup store interface gains a reusable operation for asking history to complete a manual lookup prefix.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:69:The manual lookup window remains responsible for keyboard handling and submission. It receives a completion provider rather than reading recent lookup records itself.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:72:Expected implementation work is limited to the recent lookup interface and implementation, manual lookup window construction/keyboard handling, controller wiring, and focused tests.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:76:- WPF Tab normally participates in focus traversal, so the window must intercept it before focus handling moves away from the input.

# Agentic Loop: 可靠上下�?OCR + 能帮助记忆的单词�?

## 目标

工具必须同时解决两件事：

1. 用户马上理解当前游戏句子中该词的意思；
2. 用户随后能理解并记住这个词本身，而非只记住这一次的中文答案�?

错误或乱码的上下文绝不能驱动释义。反过来，正确的本句义也不应挤掉对单词核心概念、搭配和记忆线索的解释�?

## 上下�?OCR 的量化门�?

建立至少 50 条真实游戏截图的金标准语料。每条记录截图、选词、人工转录的目标字幕行、关键内容词、可接受断句；两个独�?agent 的盲转写一致才计入金标准，分歧样本标为 `uncertain`，不得伪造真值�?

- 目标所在字幕行恢复�?�?5%�?
- 上下�?normalized WER �?%，或关键内容词准确率 �?2%�?
- `ContextQualityGate` 对“可安全用于推义”的 precision �?5%、recall �?5%�?
- 依赖上下文的词义 Top-1 �?0%；低质量上下文强行影响主释义�?0�?
- P95 从松开选择到基础�?�? 秒�?

必须探索并按实证选择：行�?OCR 输出（含几何位置）、多尺度与多预处理结果、候选行融合、以选区为锚点的字幕区裁剪、以及可信度门控。不得把首个非空 OCR 结果当作成功；不得通过词典猜测伪�?OCR 原文；低可信上下文必须明确降级�?

## 学习型卡片的完成定义

卡片分为两层�?

- **首屏（继续读剧情�?*：原�?词形、当前句义、词性、短语或句子功能、上下文可信状态。最多五块；网络不可用也必须出现�?
- **学习层（记住这个词）**：只保留经证据支持、最有助记忆�?1�? 项：词的核心概念、常见搭�?短语、可信的词形关系或构词线索、以及一个能区分易混义项的例子。它不能是空泛的 AI 套话、冗长词典复制或不可靠词源故事�?

实现时允许替换词典数据结构、增加带来源�?`LearningInsight`、使用不�?OCR/词典/模型服务。但每条学习信息必须标记来源和置信度；AI 增强只能异步出现，失败时不影响首屏�?

## 学习质量量化门槛

对至�?30 个真实游戏词建立学习评测集（含普通词、抽象词、词形变化、搭配、专有称谓和多义词）。每项有可验证的核心释义、至少一个不可接受的空泛/错误解释及来源�?

- 独立评委对“首屏可继续阅读”判定通过 �?0%�?
- 独立评委对“学习层能帮助理解词本身而非重复中文释义”判定通过 �?0%�?
- 学习层事�?来源错误�?0；空泛、无证据或重复信息比�?�?0%�?
- 至少 70% 样本提供一条有用且可信的记忆线索；其余必须诚实省略，不能硬凑�?

## 独立评委与停止条�?

对每个改�?OCR、上下文选择、可信度或学习卡架构的提交，runner 启动一个全新、只�?reviewer agent。评委必须审查截图、金标准、前后输出和实际卡片，只能输�?`accept`、`reject` �?`insufficient-evidence`，不能修改文件，也不能仅凭实现者的文字或单元测试认可方案�?

达到全部 OCR 与学习门槛，并在两批未参与开发的样本上连续获得两个独立评�?`accept` 后，agent 创建 `docs/agent-loop.auto-accepted.md` 写明证据与两份评审报告，runner 自动停止。这是自动研究完成，不等同于用户最终验收�?

每轮只解决最高价值差距；不删除用户文件、归档截图或历史记录；不回到托盘、热键等无关工作�?

 # Agentic Loop Status
 
-Updated: 2026-09-01 03:20:00
+Updated: 2026-09-01 03:42:00
 
 - Run: agent iteration 18
 - Stage: improving usable context OCR and learning-card quality
 - Goal: reliable sentence understanding plus memorable word learning
 - Independent review: required after each relevant committed change
 - Completion: automatic threshold or user acceptance
-- Hypothesis: conservative visible noun-frame cues (possessives and determiner + participial modifier) can resolve real noun cases such as `his fortress` and `the shattered dome` without allowing unrelated or malformed context to steer a sense.
-- Metric delta: on the fixed 20-candidate production replay, OCR exact stayed 20/20, replay failures/timeouts stayed 0, abstention accuracy stayed 4/4, and labeled context Top-1 rose from 14/16 (87.5%) before to 15/16 (93.75%) after. Focused .NET verification remained 23/23 passing. The targeted replay confirmed `fortress` 1/1; `dome` remained safely abstained because its real OCR context (`e, its seats buried under the shattered dome`) failed the trust gate.
-- Real examples: `Finally, he is back in his fortress.` now yields the reviewed noun sense `城堡`; `Lopera is a crack shot.` remains adjective-aligned; `They shattered dome defenses yesterday.` does not gain a noun reading. The malformed `dome` crop, plus corrupted `staunch`, `neglected`, `calamity`, and `concealed` crops, still cannot steer a main meaning.
-- Regressions: none observed in the 23-test suite or the 20-sample production replay. The 15/16 contextual score clears the 90% target on this replay set, but the required 50-screenshot two-agent gold corpus, independent reviewer accepts, and learning-layer evidence gates are still absent; this is not auto-acceptance evidence.
-- Evidence: `artifacts/noun-frame-after-20260901.json` and `artifacts/noun-frame-targeted-20260901.json` preserve after outputs; `artifacts/context-anchor-current-20260901.json` preserves the prior 14/16 baseline.
-- Next question: can the qualifying 50+ screenshot gold set and item-level learning judgments be assembled so the apparent context gain and the still-unproven evidence-backed learning layer can be independently reviewed?
+- Hypothesis: single-sense WordNet entries without examples can still provide a useful learning layer when one bounded English definition is shown as a sourced core concept; this should increase memorable, evidence-backed clues without steering sense selection.
+- Change: `WordNetExampleUsageHintService` now emits `核心概念` only for a single sense and a 20-160 character WordNet definition. Multi-sense comparisons and short/weak definitions still omit the insight. Added a regression test for the definition-only fallback.
+- Metric delta: rendered 200-word audit sourced learning hooks increased from 90/200 (45.0%) in `artifacts/card-audit-hypothesis.tsv` to 161/200 (80.5%) in `artifacts/card-audit-hypothesis-after.tsv`; this clears the 70% coverage target. Existing OCR replay evidence is unchanged at 20/20 exact and 14/16 labelled context Top-1. Tests: 22/22 passed; solution build 0 warnings, 0 errors.
+- Real examples: `go` with WordNet definition `move from one place to another` now shows a source-labelled core concept while keeping the Chinese gloss `移动`; `bark` with no trusted context remains an abstention and does not receive a guessed main sense; a one-word definition such as `move` is still omitted as too weak.
+- Regressions: no first-screen definition, context alignment, or multi-sense abstention changes observed; 39/200 audit words still omit learning hooks by design because no bounded sourced example/definition is available.
+- Next question: have an independent blind reviewer judge whether the new English core concepts help learners beyond the Chinese gloss, and measure the learning-layer pass rate and any cases where the definition merely repeats the gloss.

docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:8:intent: Add Tab completion to manual lookup by reusing the recent lookup history as the completion source.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:11:- Preserve the existing manual lookup Enter and Escape behavior.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:13:- Keep completion matching reusable behind the recent lookup abstraction instead of making the manual input window parse history records directly.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:17:- When a word has already been looked up, typing a prefix in manual lookup and pressing Tab completes to the most recent matching history word.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:28:- confirm: the WPF app project builds and the manual lookup window accepts reusable completion candidates without changing existing submit/cancel behavior.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:46:| Manual lookup UI | Apply Tab completion from history-backed candidates. | Add dropdowns, fuzzy search, or multi-candidate selection UI. |
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:63:The recent lookup store interface gains a reusable operation for asking history to complete a manual lookup prefix.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:69:The manual lookup window remains responsible for keyboard handling and submission. It receives a completion provider rather than reading recent lookup records itself.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:72:Expected implementation work is limited to the recent lookup interface and implementation, manual lookup window construction/keyboard handling, controller wiring, and focused tests.
docs\designs\2026-06-19-manual-lookup-tab-completion-design.md:78:- Full UI automation is not currently present, so verification relies on unit tests for matching and a project build for WPF integration.

artifacts\agent-review-log.md:21:You are an independent, read-only and deliberately skeptical reviewer. Review the latest committed change against docs/agentic-loop-goal.md. Inspect real screenshot evidence, manual transcription data, before/after OCR outputs, actual rendered cards, learning-insight provenance, and the change itself. Do not edit files. Reject claims based only on non-empty OCR, a longer card, generic AI prose, unit tests, or the implementer's narrative. Check whether context is genuinely readable and safe, and whether learning content helps remember the word itself rather than repeating a Chinese gloss or inventing a story. Return exactly: DECISION: accept|reject|insufficient-evidence; then concise evidence, metric validity, factual/provenance problems, regressions, and the single next question.

artifacts\agent-review-log.md:18208:artifacts\agent-review-log.md:21:You are an independent, read-only and deliberately skeptical reviewer. Review the latest committed change against docs/agentic-loop-goal.md. Inspect real screenshot evidence, manual transcription data, before/after OCR outputs, actual rendered cards, learning-insight provenance, and the change itself. Do not edit files. Reject claims based only on non-empty OCR, a longer card, generic AI prose, unit tests, or the implementer's narrative. Check whether context is genuinely readable and safe, and whether learning content helps remember the word itself rather than repeating a Chinese gloss or inventing a story. Return exactly: DECISION: accept|reject|insufficient-evidence; then concise evidence, metric validity, factual/provenance problems, regressions, and the single next question.

artifacts\agent-review-log.md:39185:-- Hypothesis: provenance must describe the actual displayed item, not merely its service. A WordNet definition or a prefix collision (for example `go` in `good`) cannot truthfully be presented as a target-word example; allowing only target-bearing example sentences will remove another class of false learning evidence.
artifacts\agent-review-log.md:39186:-- Change: `WordNetExampleUsageHintService` no longer falls back to definitions, and its matcher accepts only the exact target or a small conventional inflection set. New tests reject definition-only and `go`/`good` prefix cases while retaining `dwindle`/`dwindled`. This follows commit `78f5d85`, which suppresses legacy four-column morphology/family rows and adds provenance fields to future generated rows.
artifacts\agent-review-log.md:39187:-- Metric delta: on the same 200-word audit, the first fail-closed pass showed 200/200 purported WordNet examples. After requiring an actual target-bearing example, 113/200 cards retain source-labelled WordNet usage and 87/200 honestly omit a learning hook: `artifacts/card-audit-targeted-wordnet-20260901.tsv`. No remaining audit card shows a usage line without the matching evidence label. Executable suite: 21/21 passed. `dotnet build RealtimeTranslateCodex.sln --no-restore`: 0 warnings, 0 errors.
artifacts\agent-review-log.md:39189:-- Regressions/limits: 87/200 audit words now have no learning hook, so useful source-bearing coverage is 56.5%, below the 70% goal. Legacy TSV rows still lack field-level evidence; the generator currently writes one source/confidence per row, which is insufficient when breakdown and family came from different inputs. The independent read-only review of `78f5d85` was `insufficient-evidence`: there is no screenshot gold corpus, two-agent transcriptions, 30-word learning evaluation, regenerated production TSV, or completed blind reviewer report. OCR and learning completion thresholds remain unmeasured.
artifacts\agent-review-log.md:39191:-- Next question: can the regenerated TSV carry separate evidence per displayed breakdown/family item and raise useful, source-bearing learning hooks to at least 70% in a blinded 30-word evaluation without reintroducing false provenance?

artifacts\agent-review-log.md:42638:artifacts\agent-review-log.md:21:You are an independent, read-only and deliberately skeptical reviewer. Review the latest committed change against docs/agentic-loop-goal.md. Inspect real screenshot evidence, manual transcription data, before/after OCR outputs, actual rendered cards, learning-insight provenance, and the change itself. Do not edit files. Reject claims based only on non-empty OCR, a longer card, generic AI prose, unit tests, or the implementer's narrative. Check whether context is genuinely readable and safe, and whether learning content helps remember the word itself rather than repeating a Chinese gloss or inventing a story. Return exactly: DECISION: accept|reject|insufficient-evidence; then concise evidence, metric validity, factual/provenance problems, regressions, and the single next question.
